verdict.rationale: PayPal Agentic Commerce is a payments and commerce service. In MCP terms it acts as a tool provider: it ships an official MCP server and an agent toolkit that plug into other agents. It is not an agent host that consumes third-party MCP servers, so the MCP-client axis is a category error. Nothing in the evidence shows the product itself connecting to external MCP servers. The ACP guide has merchants build their own MCP server for ChatGPT to call, which is also server-side, so the axis does not flip to applicable.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
